Overview

Cast Resin Dry-Type Transformer

Cast-resin dry-type transformers for fire-sensitive, indoor and infrastructure applications. The current evidence set covers SCB18 1000 kVA and 2500 kVA models at 10 kV.

Applications

  • Commercial buildings
  • Hospitals
  • Charging infrastructure
  • Industrial facilities
  • Rail and public infrastructure

Key Advantages

  • Flame-retardant cast-resin insulation
  • Low maintenance
  • Low partial-discharge design direction
  • Temperature monitoring options
  • Protective enclosure options

FAQ

Product Review Questions

Where are cast-resin transformers typically installed?

They are commonly considered for indoor, fire-sensitive, occupied or environmentally constrained sites.

Does the series include forced-air cooling?

AN and AF arrangements can be reviewed for the selected model and enclosure.

Related Knowledge

Questions to confirm before project selection

FAQ

What is transformer K-factor?

K-factor indicates the transformer's ability to carry specified nonlinear load currents without exceeding its thermal limits.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

What transformer is suitable for a data center?

Data center transformer selection usually emphasizes fire safety, harmonic loading, efficiency, reliability, noise and integration with busway or switchgear.

Read engineering answer →

FAQ

Cast resin vs VPI dry-type transformer: what is the difference?

Cast resin embeds the winding in a solid resin body, while VPI impregnates the winding insulation with varnish under vacuum and pressure.

Read engineering answer →
